text: Our environment needs our help. Every day, people make a lot of trash, and much of it is plastic, paper, and glass. Plastic bottles and bags can hurt animals in the forest and in the sea. At my school, we learn how to recycle. We put paper in one bin and plastic and glass in another bin. This helps keep our town clean, not dirty. At home, my family tries to save water and not waste food. We also reuse old bags when we go shopping. Last weekend, we went to the forest to plant new trees. Trees are important because they give us clean air and a home for animals. Pollution from cars and factories is bad for nature, so we try to walk or ride bikes instead of using a car. My teacher says small actions can protect the environment for the future. I want animals and forests to stay safe for my children too. If everyone helps a little, we can keep our planet clean and beautiful.
